content.title: What features do you want in your favorite app this Ramadan?
content.subtitle: Share your feedback to make Muslims Day even more meaningful!
content.body:
The rush to wake up before Suhoor time, checking prayer schedules amid a busy day, or becoming absorbed in supplication right before Iftar—every day of Ramadan passes in a beautiful discipline of time. Over the past days, your favorite app, Muslims Day, has served as a companion in organizing your daily acts of worship smoothly through prayer reminders, accurate Suhoor and Iftar timings, the Holy Quran, and morning-evening duas.

It is not just an app; it is your trusted companion

We believe Muslims Day is not merely a piece of software; rather, it is a trusted and constant companion for your daily worship and self-purification. When you open the app to read the Quran seeking a moment of peace amid your busyness, get up for Wudu with a Miswak in hand as soon as the prayer alarm rings, or spend time in morning and evening Dhikr—we feel proud to be part of those beautiful moments. Therefore, this platform belongs to you even more than it belongs to us.

May the upcoming Ramadan be more organized and blessed

With the passage of time, Ramadan, the month of mercy and forgiveness, is knocking at our door once again. We want this upcoming month to become even easier, more beautiful, and more blessed in your life. To help organize your worship further and keep you in the remembrance of your Lord even amid busyness, we are working on several new features. Yet, no one knows your needs and expectations better than you do.

Let a single thought of yours become a guide for millions

How exactly do you want to see your own app look in the upcoming Ramadan? In which area of worship would an easier solution have felt better to you? That wonderful idea in your mind could become the very soul of our next update. A small suggestion from you might make Ramadan easier for millions of Muslim brothers and sisters—and you too will become a partner in that Sadaqah Jariyah.
